papers.title_en: Gradient-extrapolation-based distributed mirror descent algorithm for multi-cluster aggregative games
papers.authors: Rui Zhu, Fuyong Wang, Zhongxin Liu, Zengqiang Chen
papers.evidence: 面向多簇聚合博弈的分布式纳什均衡求解，算法可迁移至多智能体分散决策问题
papers.tldr: 针对多集群聚合博弈中合作与竞争共存、代价函数依赖自身策略与全局聚合的问题，在非欧几里得设置下提出一种带梯度外推的分布式镜像下降算法。算法利用Bregman散度作为距离度量，并结合历史梯度信息提升收敛性。在受限强单调条件下证明了算法的收敛性，并以适当参数达到O(1/k)收敛率，最后通过能源需求响应算例验证有效性。
papers.abstract_en: This paper studies a class of multi-cluster aggregative games characterized by the coexistence of cooperation and competition, where each agent's cost function depends on its own strategy and the aggregate of all agents' strategies. To address the Nash equilibrium seeking problem for such games in the non-Euclidean setting, a distributed mirror descent algorithm with gradient extrapolation is proposed over time-varying intra-cluster and inter-cluster networks. The mirror descent framework employs a general Bregman divergence as the distance measure, providing greater flexibility than Euclidean-based methods, while gradient extrapolation exploits historical gradient information to improve convergence performance. Under the restricted strong monotonicity characterized by the Bregman divergence, the convergence of the proposed algorithm is established, and it achieves the $\mathcal{O}(1/k)$ convergence rate with the appropriately selected step-size and parameters. Finally, the effectiveness of the proposed algorithm is verified by an example on the demand response of energy systems.
